lines.en: label nodokaspring1:
scene nodokaoutside1
I knock on Nodoka’s door and wait for her to answer.
I figure that, if she’s going to get in on this whole apocalypse deal, it’s probably best if I give her some orientation.
And by “orientation,” I mean penis.
What I’m saying is that I am here to have sex with her.
scene nodokaoutside2
: Oh. What are you doing here?
: Darn it. Looks like I’ll just have to have sex with Otoha instead.
: Why? Do you have some sort of quota you need to fill by the end of the day or something?

: As she stood there in those pajamas, which made her like five times more attractive than normal, I thought to myself, “Is it really her I’m after? Or just the thrill of chasing after an unobtainable goal?”
scene nodokaoutside3
: Damn, five times? Really? I figured it was like three at best.
: But as she gazed down at her own figure instead of mine, I knew that the answer was “neither.” And that I truly was living out the rest of my existence in a hell of my own creation.
scene nodokaoutside4
: You done?
: The end. Now, I’m done. Where’s Nodoka?
: I don’t know. Home, probably. Why?
: You don’t know?
: I’m her roommate, not her babysitter. I think you’ve confused our dynamic with Dorm 9’s.
: Nodoka needs a babysitter just as badly as Yasu and you know it.
: Oh, chill. I’m sure she’s just fine wherever she is right now.
scene nodokaoutside5
: WHERE THE FUCK AM I AND HOW DID I GET HERE?!
She was not fine.
For, once more, she had escaped the boundaries of the hit 2020 video game “Lessons in Love” and found herself in the loading screen of something else.

It was a place where things were, somehow, even worse. A slice of life you’d never want on your plate, where the reception was so bad that you couldn’t even slap a denpa sticker on it and call it a day.
scene nodokaoutside6
This perturbed her.
: I’m so perturbed!
, she thought to herself out loud because thoughts weren’t held to the same standards here that they are in areas where narration mostly makes cents.
scene nodokaoutside7
A joke. I misspoke. It’s supposed to be “sense” and not “cents” like I wrote.

Just sometimes it’s easier to showcase how wonky and crazy broken realities can be without the presence of some guy with squiggly eyes. So you rely on literary tricks like wordplay or swordplay and rewrite the way language works.
It’s more complex and nuanced than just shifting where plurality resides, though, for that leaves nothing do with sword like deer or mouse. How can you fix what comes out of the box broken?
We all know the best course of action when that happens is to just send the box back to Amazon and complain until you get a new one. Did you know they’ll just do that now?
You can just lie and they’ll be like “okay” then send you back a whole new box of [[PENDING NOUN WITH REVERSED PLURALIZATION THAT WOULD MAKE THIS SENTENCE CLEVER AND FUNNY].
scene nodokaoutside8
There were three things going through her head right now — thoughts, meat, and bone.
Swimming through those thoughts, however, was a specific thought that I will now tell you about because I’ve finally figured it out after staring so deeply into unsquiggled squiggly eyes.
A memory. A premonition. Or perhaps something in between that would help her complete her mission.

Like a dog, she was at her best when she was wet. Kind of like Number Girl in that TV show about all of those strange things who couldn’t use her powers unless she was taking a bath. What a great idea that was.
Anyway, the thought was this — run.

Not in the direction of where the bus goes, but the direction the bus is supposed to go in because you can’t reach the past by going backward. You must lap it. Less like the dog and more like its dish.
And so she would.
scene nodokaoutside9
And so she did.

Now, here in this rectangular bathysphere holding out the pressure of persistence, she successfully avoided drowning and had come one step closer to firmly stroking an inkling until it dyes her cheeks black with the fruits of aroused elation.
scene nodokaoutside10
: Wha...
I have always been a dot. A speck. The kind you can’t get out. I rest in your subconscious thoughts, embedded in the grout.
I can’t be cleaned. I must be killed. No vinegar nor bleach can ever collect all the things you’ve dropped when in your reach.
Do you remember now?
Where you are, Nodoka?
Where this is?
Your future. Your past. The halls where you were made and the halls where you will die.
Like the moon, it’s all one perfect circle.
Rest, my child. Be safe here in my womb.
: This...is not my school.
scene nodokaoutside11
: And class doesn’t start for HOURS! I still have to BRUSH MY HAIR!!!!
scene nodokaoutside12
: The library...
: I must go to the library. I can wait there until tomorrow comes and explain to everyone that I have come here by means I am presently unaware of.
: I am God. I am omnipresent. But I am here because of a wrong turn that must be RECTIFIED lest that elusive fox escape me once more!
: I will catch you, pink bitch! And when I do, I will bleed the answers from you like I am the lamprey and you are the fish I’ve found to drink!
: Hi!
scene nodokaoutside13
scene nodokaoutside14
: AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH!
: Who the fuck are you and where is your third dimension?!
: I left it back at hoooooooome! Why are you so loud, Nodoka-chan?!
scene nodokaoutside15
: Drop your pleasantries and remind me why I’m here if we’re so familiar! The last thing I remember is a hole!
: We’re in the womb! Weren’t you listening to the narrator just now?
: I am the narrator and I said no such thing! Are you a figment of my imagination or a paranormal entity I can fornicate with?! Answer me!
: F-F-Fornicate?! Right here?! Right now?!
: How else am I supposed to make it until dawn?! If I’m going to hallucinate ghosts, you better damn believe I’m going to fuck them too!
: Nodoka-chan, relax! I’ll explain everything! The same way I always do!
scene nodokaoutside16
: What do you mean always? Who are you, exactly?
: Ai-chan! The elusive fox you were talking about a minute ago? That’s me! And you came here to-
scene nodokaoutside17
: Right! I remember everything now! You’re here to help me find the door!
: Wow! You’re getting so much better at this! It took you almost two minutes to remember who I was last time.

: Things have changed since then. I’ve been sucked into what my peers are referring to as some sort of indefinite apocalyptic rift in time and space. One that, for some reason, I’m now allowed to experience alongside them.
: But why? The timing is odd. And if I am still able to find this layer of suspended reality and dream up the same demons who haunt my mother, how am I to believe that what those peers say is true?
: That’s where Ai comes in! It’s where I come in!
scene nodokaoutside18
: Spare me your swordplay, Ai-chan! Your name is far detached from the feelings I feel for you in this moment!
: Nodoka-chan, you’ve already answered these questions yourself! In the past and in the future!
: That compulsion you had to go to the library a few seconds ago wasn’t just so you could wait for sunrise! That was an echo of your past! A rumbling in your tummy to warn you that you’re hungry!
: I see. So I’ve left something in the library that will fill in the gaps of my consciousness.
: Hmm...maybe you’re not getting any better at this? You normally at least know that you’re looking for something whenever you show up here.
: In fact, I don’t really get how you got here at all without knowing that. But I guess that doesn’t matter since the whole point of working as a team is helping each other!
: What do you get from me then? Where does my benefit become a mutual one?
: I just love helping people! The smiles of my friends and family are the only things that can bring a smile to my face! And I love smiling! Smile with me, Nodoka-chan!
scene nodokaoutside19
: You think I have time to smile?!
: Didn’t you just say you’re part of some sort of indefinite apocalypse rift or something?
: In essence, yes!
: Wouldn’t that mean you have tons of time then?

: Not here, you stupid fox! The context of this meeting implies I have limited time to accomplish whatever short-term goals will bring me closer to opening the door and now you’re here padding the fucking word count instead of moving the plot forward!
: Kyoko always hated when books dragged on too. You smart girls always make my brain hurt. I just want to have fun!
: Then show me where the fucking library is and go find a picture book or something!
scene nodokaoutside20
: Okay! Here we are.
: Where are all the lights?
: They haven’t worked here in centuries.
scene nodokaoutside21
: Centuries? You’ve been here that long?
: Yup-yup! My existence is tied to yours, so I’m not allowed to leave until you do! And whenever you’re not here, I’m just suspended in a state of physical and mental paralysis!
: Why am I not surprised?
: Because you made me say that!
scene nodokaoutside22
: In any event, I must find whatever information I left myself. It’s likely absolutely essential if I stashed it so deeply in the manifested depths of my mind.
: It definitely is! Your research has always been so important to you, Nodoka-chan! Which is why I’m so surprised that the memories of it seem to be slipping away!
: I will whack you over the head with a wet floor sign if you so much as mention slipping in my presence again.
: Please, no! Physical abuse is even worse than the mental kind! And that’s even more true when swordplay is involved!
: The archives. Where are they? My gut is telling me that’s where I must go.
: To the left. But-
scene nodokaoutside23
: Hey! Aren’t you going to listen to my warning? It’s super-duper important!
: Bullshit! The only thing that’s important here is listening to the real me instead of this personified echo, just to hearken back to terminology you used at my omniscient behest, fox.
: You know, “fox” isn’t really a good insult, Nodoka-chan. Have you ever actually seen a fox in real life? They’re super cute and super funny!
: Yes, and so are sea urchins but you don’t see teenage girls snapping photos of them and posting them all over the fucking Internet.
: Okay, well we clearly have two very different definitions of what it means to be cute and funny. But still! You need to be careful when you’re in there!
: Why? Are you tempted to stab me in the back or something?
: Of course not! There’s nothing Ai hates more than violence. There’s nothing I hate more than violence!
: But you and me aren’t the only ones who exist here, Nodoka-chan! This is a school after all. There’s security all over the place to make sure nobody gets sodomized!
: And they’ve been working overtime lately making sure nobody is walking around with uncensored ponytails. Do you like ponytails, Nodoka-chan?
: Of course I do. It’s the most sexual haircut. But I’m not about to sit here and discuss why and how when there are things for me to find!
: Totally understandable! I’ll just float over and keep myself occupied with a little song then.
: Daaaaaaaisy, Daaaaaisy. Give me your answer, doooooooo.
scene nodokaoutside24
: Something less creepy and cliche! Why must I always distract myself from focusing on myself?!
: That’s the only song I know! Shiori-chan always hogs the radio and we only get an hour each week!
: Am I supposed to care?! With the fate of whatever I’m supposed to be protecting hanging in the balance?!
: You don’t even know?! Nodoka-chan, this is super bad! Your connection to the womb is hanging on by a thread at this point and not a whole umbilical cord!
scene nodokaoutside25
: I know! Which is why it’s absolutely paramount that you-
scene nodokaoutside26
: What’s this?
scene nodokaoutside27
: What’s up? Did you find something? Is it DRUGS?
: Better. It’s information.
: Again, I just don’t think we’re ever going to see eye to eye on some things. What’s it say?
: It says...
scene black
scene nodokaoutside28
: Uhh...
: Well?
: It’s fucking pixellated. I can’t read it.
: Oh! I can help with that!
: What? How?! Why? How? What?
: I exist in the same part of your brain that you use to be creative! You know, the one that’s caught in a perpetual war against your logical side?
: And that side is also used to de-censor dialogue?
: Nope! But if you use your imagination, you can make those words say anything you want them to!
: But that’s not-
: Here! Let’s turn them into a happy message to brighten up your day!
scene nodokaoutside29
: Oh, good! More cliche horror. Thank you very much, Ai-chan! This makes everything SO MUCH FUCKING BETTER!
: At least there’s a smiley face! Nothing bad has ever happened with a- mpphhhfhfhfh??!!!??!!!
: Use my imagination...I can change it! I just need to imagine what I’ve said before!
: MMMMMMMMMNNNHHHHHFHFHFHFHFHFH!!!!!
scene nodokaoutside30
: Can you shut up?! I’m so close to...well, something! But I can’t figure out what that something is while you’re making silly background noises!
scene nodokaoutside31
: Thank you...Now, let’s see here. I just need to-
: Oh. Well, fuck me I guess. There’s another page.
: To my past or present self — when the grass seems greener on the other side, what you’re seeing is chartreuse.
scene nodokaoutside32
: Forget everything you know about landscaping and...pray for sand instead. Fear the Gardener. The weeds have overgrown. And while they feed us in these times of need, they...
scene nodokaoutside33
: ...are doused in poisons you would not believe even if I were to include comprehensive analyses of their chemical compositions and...the effects they have on girls like you.
: The answers you seek are buried beneath your feet. The question you must ask now is how you’re meant to...dig?
: What? What was I-
scene nodokaoutside34
scene black
